BinaryModel must retain exactly its scaler and learner, correct roles, distinct IDs, learner ID=model.id, empty standalone scaler upstream, and learner upstream=(scaler.id,).

CalibratedBinary must retain its exact calibration scaler/learner metadata and root role/ID/upstream pair; the earlier base is independently reopened against its own actual fold.
